events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $6.43 (model confidence 0.72)
events.body:
The trip is RydeTAXI (metered), so a route deviation feeds directly into the fare; the record shows one off-route segment [F3] driven 21:39–21:49, 6.27 km where the optimal route covers 1.71 km, i.e. +4.56 km, and the fare confirms the excess distance was billed ($6.77 = 4.80 km × $1.4100/km) [F4][F7]. That segment is an unexcused deviation unless RD-3, RD-4 or RD-5 excuses it [RD-1][RD-2].

RD-4 fails: there is no LTA incident on the replaced stretch, and speed band 5 (40–49 km/h) on the expressway and Kampong Bahru Road is ordinary traffic that cannot exempt a segment on its own [F12][F13][F14][RD-4].

RD-3 does not apply either: the driver proposed the stop, not the rider, and no stop was measured within the segment. The rider's "Sure, no problem" [F9] is a reply to the driver's own message asking to "pull in at the petrol station just ahead for one minute" [F8]; even if that were treated as a rider-requested stop, the rider never named a place and the record shows no stop happened, so RD-3(a) cannot exempt the whole 4.56 km way there [RD-3].

Under RD-5 the rider's agreement [F9] was to a short stop, sent before the segment start, and it only covers that stop — not an unexplained 6.27 km loop that the driver himself describes as "a small change of route" [F11]; the driver's own statement confirms the agreement was to a stop, not to the route driven. Consent does not reach this segment [RD-5]. The driver's after-the-fact statement cannot supply consent [F11] (G11); the chat is complete and fully timestamped, so no timing gap [F10].

Amount: only the metered distance attributable to the unexcused segment is refundable, because $1.71 of the 6.27 km is the optimal-route distance the rider would have paid anyway; the net excess is 4.56 km × $1.4100/km = $6.4296 → $6.43 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. The $0.11 waiting entry is a metered waiting unit, not a stop charge, and is not refunded [F5][RD-3(c)]. No account flag: the driver has no prior upheld route dispute (route: 0) in 90 days [F16][F17][RD-6].

ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $6.43 Ryde voucher to the rider (RydeTAXI metered overcharge for the unexcused detour) and record the driver's RD-1 breach; no account flag.
